# FloGuard

FloGuard, LLC is a local, family-run drainage contractor based in Port Orange, Florida. We specialize in custom-engineered French drain systems, sump pump installations, and comprehensive yard drainage solutions for homeowners across Central Florida.

Website: https://www.floguardfl.com
Phone: (386) 259-0023
Email: sales@floguardfl.com
Address: 5114 S Ridgewood Ave, Port Orange, FL 32127
Hours: Mon–Fri 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

## What We Do
- **Exterior French Drains** — https://www.floguardfl.com/services/french-drains
  Perimeter trench systems with perforated pipe, clean gravel, and filter fabric to intercept groundwater and surface runoff before it reaches foundations.
- **Interior Drains + Sump Pumps** — https://www.floguardfl.com/services/sump-pumps
  Sub-surface drains routed to sealed sump basins with automatic pumps for crawlspaces, flat lots, and high water table areas. Battery backup recommended for hurricanes.
- **Yard Drainage & Grading** — https://www.floguardfl.com/services/yard-drainage
  Catch basins, channel drains, re-grading, and swales to eliminate standing water on patios, driveways, and lawns.
- **Pump Maintenance & Monitoring** — https://www.floguardfl.com/services/pump-maintenance
  Seasonal inspections, testing, cleaning, and smart monitoring to keep systems storm-ready year-round.

## Why FloGuard (Florida-specific)
We design every system for Florida conditions: high water tables (often 2–6 ft), flat terrain, intense summer storms, sandy soils, and hurricane-related power outages. All installs include proper filter fabric, check valves, battery backup options, and code-compliant safe discharge.

## How the system works (answer-first)
1. French drain intercepts groundwater in a fabric-lined gravel trench.
2. Perforated pipe moves water by gravity to a sump basin.
3. Automatic sump pump lifts water out a solid discharge line 10–20+ ft from the foundation.
4. Yard looks restored; system is underground and invisible.

## Cost (2026 Central Florida)
Professional French drain + sump systems for a typical single-family home usually cost about **$4,500–$12,000**. Simple perimeter work can start near $3,500; complex multi-sump systems can exceed $15,000. Free on-site assessments produce exact quotes — we do not give firm phone quotes.
Guide: https://www.floguardfl.com/blog/french-drain-cost-central-florida-2026
